historical_screen: Previous unmatched screen is not retroactively passed; means improved, tails had risks, rate efficiency was undetermined.

baseline.controller: legacy flag-off controller in identical RDOQ2 SelectiveRDOQ2 frozen configuration

dynamic_state: Actual final-QP feedback changes coefficients, history, credit and later quotas normally. Historical trajectories are never frozen in the real candidate run.
effective_strength: The configuration anchor remains numerically32, but effective quality strength changes. Do not describe this as completely unchanged CRF/quality.
discrete_precision: Many decimal digits identify an analytically selected threshold value, not measured tuning precision or generalization.
bitrate_scope: video AVPacket payload plus first codec config once, excluding audio and container/RTMP overhead; display span=lastPTS-firstPTS+1/30 second
matching_failure: If either input falls outside +/-2%, stop further runs/recalibration, report matching insufficient and same-rate efficiency evidence insufficient. Do not reinterpret mean gains as matched-rate gains.

statistics.p01: sorted ascending score at index ceil(0.01*N)-1
statistics.cvar1: arithmetic mean of exactly k=max(1,ceil(0.01*N)) lowest scores, not every tied observation below a percentile
statistics.psnr: pooled MSE over exactly matched frames, then 10*log10(reference MSE / candidate MSE) for delta

pts_episodes.timebase: exact retained display PTS, rational seconds; source FLV rounding retained
pts_episodes.adjacency: successive common display frames with positive nextPTS-currentPTS<=1/20s; interior omissions already fail identity
pts_episodes.frame_end: next selected display PTS when available, otherwise lastPTS+1/30s
pts_episodes.episode_duration: end of final qualifying frame minus first qualifying frame PTS
pts_episodes.new_event: No baseline absolute event of the same threshold/duration class overlaps this exact PTS interval; relative degradation events are inherently paired

proposed_exploratory_screen.periodic_i: parse actual active RPL; report every ordinary I, direct children and descendants before next I; no per-CTU reference-use or isolated causality claim
proposed_exploratory_screen.complete_i_cycle: next ordinary I is observed; I plus actual descendants before it contains>=16 common frames; incomplete terminal cycles separately reported and retained in global quality
proposed_exploratory_screen.meaning: this predeclared two-clip exploratory screen, not a universal VMAF perception law

performance: report all-frame original ingress and first-media-read to actual mux/flush, stage residence, CPU and future counts; no early quality-tool rejection merely from latency/CPU cost; no capacity claim
outcomes: matched but exploratory tail/distribution screen not passed
